# chalk_environment_source_bundle_cloud_storage_binding (Resource)

Binds a cloud storage to environment for the **SOURCE_BUNDLE** role.

The role is fixed by the resource type. Bindings are keyed by `(environment_id, role)` — the environment has at most one storage for this role — so this resource is identified by the environment_id, not by `cloud_storage_id`. Every attribute is replace-only (there is no update RPC).

~> **Delete removes whatever occupies the (environment, SOURCE_BUNDLE) slot.** Deletes target `(environment_id, role)` (not a binding id), so a stale plan can delete a binding created out-of-band for the same environment and role. If the storage in the slot is reassigned outside Terraform, the next plan reconciles `cloud_storage_id` and schedules a recreate.

**Required permissions:** `project.create` *(team-scoped)*

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The role is fixed by the resource type; the referenced cloud storage is
# bound to the env for that role. At most one storage per (environment_id, role).

resource "chalk_environment_source_bundle_cloud_storage_binding" "example" {
  environment_id   = "your-env-id"
  cloud_storage_id = chalk_unmanaged_cloud_storage.source_bundle.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_storage_id` (String) The ID of the cloud storage to bind. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment to bind the cloud storage to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp at which the binding was created.
- `id` (String) Binding identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp at which the binding was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Bindings are imported by the target id alone; the role is fixed by the type.
terraform import chalk_environment_source_bundle_cloud_storage_binding.example your-env-id
```
